title: 【Student Dormitory】– Illustration Meetings of the Student Dormitory Committee Election for Academic Year 2025-2026
content:

標題： 【Student Dormitory】– Illustration Meetings of the Student Dormitory Committee Election for Academic Year 2025-2026
日期： Mon, 3 Mar 2025 08:46:39 +0800

Dear Students,
    It’s time again for the annual election for the dormitory committee. In order for the student to learn about the election, we will have a meeting on 3/4(Tue) and 3/5(Wed) at the Student Dormitory Complex. Participating students will be rewarded one hour of Muti-Discplinary Learning credits.

Meeting agenda:
1. Briefing of the Student Dormitory Committee:
    (1) Regulations and structure 
    (2) Duties and responsibilities
    (3) Election and recruiting
2. Questions, comments or opinions.

Time and Location
(1) 3/4(Tue)18:30, Dormitory 7
(2) 3/4(Tue)20:00, Dormitory 6
(3) 3/5(Wed)18:30, Dormitory 3
(4) 3/5(Wed)20:00, Dormitory 2

If you have any question, please contact: Mr. Chung at (03)890-6217
